mentions.name: AgentMode
mentions.description: A hosted version of OpenClaw that provides one-click deployment of a full AI agent with configurable skills and channels, with each user getting their own isolated sandbox environment on Cloudflare Workers, handling VPS setup, Docker, API keys, and security patching.
mentions.problem: Setting up OpenClaw is a pain: VPS, Docker, API keys in plaintext, security patches.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://agentmode.co

Hosted OpenClaw, one click and you get a full agent with configurable skills, channels and the whole thing, all running in its own sandbox.
